title: SVAMC Guidelines on the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Arbitration
instrument: Silicon Valley Arbitration & Mediation Center, Guidelines on the Use of AI in Arbitration (1st ed., 2024)
description: Soft-law guidance for arbitrators and parties, often adopted in a first procedural order.

requirements.title: Understanding uses, limitations and risks
requirements.text: Participants understand what an AI tool does and where it can fail.

requirements.title: Safeguarding confidentiality
requirements.text: Confidential material is not exposed through an AI tool.

requirements.title: Disclosure
requirements.text: Whether AI use must be disclosed is decided case by case.

requirements.title: Non-delegation of decision-making
requirements.text: Arbitrators do not delegate any part of their decision.
requirements.instruction: Do not reach, suggest or draft any decision of the tribunal, whether on procedure, evidence or the merits.

requirements.title: Respect for due process
requirements.text: An arbitrator does not rely on AI-generated information outside the record without disclosing it to the parties and, as far as practical, letting them comment.
requirements.statement: Any information from this work outside the record that I rely on will be disclosed to the parties for comment.
